engineering_database_queries.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS minimax_docs (
            source_path VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
            content LONGTEXT NOT NULL,
            sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
            metadata_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS minimax_meta (
            meta_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            meta_value LONGTEXT NOT NULL
        )

SELECT source_path, kind, content, sha256, metadata_json FROM minimax_docs WHERE (LOCATE(%s, LOWER(content)) > 0 OR LOCATE(%s, LOWER(source_path)) > 0) OR (LOCATE(%s, LOWER(content)) > 0 OR LOCATE(%s, LOWER(source_path)) > 0) ORDER BY source_path
